limitations: Hypothesis SUPPORTED is scoped to the PO-03 suite at commit 7bbe7b45aaffe6e4461791d3a06482e5ec81f575 on one Linux runner with Python 3.12.3, git 2.43.0 and 8 CPUs. Recurrence is shown across independent clean clones on that machine, not across operating systems, Python versions or hosted runners.

The integration-ready workflow is delivered as po03-clean-clone.yml.candidate inside this unit's subtree because .github/workflows/po03-*.yml is controller-owned. It has therefore never executed in GitHub Actions and no workflow-run URL exists for it.

first_pass_outcome is FAIL_THEN_REPAIRED, not PASS. Six defects in this unit's own code and fixtures were found and repaired, two of them by the gate assessing this unit's own delivered commit: it had staged four .pyc files, and its first checkout-mutation assertion wrongly treated bytecode caches as semantic mutation.

All 64 Wave A immutable inputs declare source_base.minimum_protocol_ancestor 100bc20ad5eec62a4f35b60921423135cc0b9d9a, which resolves to no object in the repository. Its seven-character prefix resolves to commit 100bc2079cedc193af3524234ab833cc9f9f4669, a genuine ancestor of the delivered commit, and the root cause is the hardcoded PROTOCOL_ANCESTOR literal on line 25 of workstreams/po03/tools/prepare_wave_a.py. Both the generator and the immutable inputs are read-only for this unit, so the defect is reported with an executable detector and a strategy proposal and is deliberately not repaired.

No external URL was read. This runner performed no web fetch, search or documentation retrieval, so external_source_claims is empty and marked NOT_SUPPORTED rather than populated with invented citations. All 16 source claims are immutable repository reads with computed SHA-256 and byte counts.

Per-subagent model attestation is NOT_SUPPORTED. The input requested claude-opus-5-thinking-high, the runtime self-identifies as Claude Opus 5, and the provider run metadata reports originalModelName gpt-5.6-sol-max-fast for the enclosing controller run. The divergence is recorded, not resolved.

Isolation is evidenced by a separate no-hardlink clone at /tmp/po03-wa-003-b1956656/runner on a unique branch, by the absence of any write to /workspace and by the ownership guard over the whole commit range. The provider exposes no separate best-of-N machine identity or signed runner attestation, so a distinct physical machine is not claimed.

CC-13 cannot attribute system temporary-directory writes to a process. During REPRO-5 it observed po03-wa-001-repro-yu7psbzr, created by a sibling Wave A runner on the same machine, so the check weakens to INCONCLUSIVE rather than FAIL when new entries appear.
CC-14 blocks only proxy-aware network clients. Raw sockets and DNS are not blocked, so full egress isolation is not claimed.

The gate neutralises ambient git configuration for its own local repository operations but does not yet assert that the suite under test is independent of it, even though this unit measured a 72x wall-time effect from the single inherited setting commit.gpgsign. That assertion is named as a successor candidate, not delivered.

This document cannot contain its own SHA-256 or byte count; both are reported in the producer terminal response and are recomputable from the immutable return commit. artifact-manifest.json likewise cannot contain its own hash, which is why this document carries it.

The ownership-guard receipt committed at result/ownership-guard.json covers the range ending at the code commit 7bbe7b45aaffe6e4461791d3a06482e5ec81f575, because a receipt cannot describe the commit that contains it. The full-range result recorded above, ending at 48b9cc2b83b001bf296c34e9726002a48937ebfa, is reproducible with the command shown.

The producer does not accept its own result. obzio_state is RESULT_COMMITTED, completion_actor is null and independent_acceptance is NOT_TESTED. Only the coordinator may record COMPLETED, and a different producer must decide the independent disposition.

This producer read /workspace but never wrote to it, and therefore cannot certify its own non-interference after returning. A distinct controller process must compare its post-return branch and HEAD against the observed pre-dispatch state, cursor/po03-wave-a-b195-1a9f at e56eda6e8e4a4e958795f7157839926d93272b30.
